title: Philosophy
message:
We value the blessings of nature and a playful spirit,
feeling the wind, light, and breath of greenery,
and create a future that is kind to people and society.
philosophy_headline: Committed to domestic production, passing on tradition to the next generation through agriculture and system development
philosophy_body:
We believe that protecting the hemp culture passed down in Japan since ancient times and carrying it into the future is not merely about preserving tradition. It is about nurturing the connections between people and nature, people and local communities, and people with one another, and building a society rich in spirit.

While cherishing the purity and vitality of hemp, as well as its power to lead people toward a calm state of mind, we will create a peaceful “hemp place” where everyone can feel at ease, and share new value where culture and daily life exist in harmony.

Living together, nurturing together, and prospering together. With this spirit in our hearts, we will carry the future of Japanese hemp on to the next generation.
